title: Pump + Filter + Fountain
goal: Build the permanent circulation and filtration system so the pond runs fishless now but has enough mechanical and biological capacity for a small, appropriate fish population later without rebuilding the system.

designIntent.futureState: Fish-ready infrastructure for a possible small fish population after the pond has been stable for about a year
designIntent.selectedVessel: Algreen Manhattan 40-inch Balcony Planter & Pond in Brownstone, purchased from Wayfair
designIntent.mainPumpTarget: Adjustable pump in roughly the 300–500 GPH rated range, sized to deliver approximately 200–300 GPH through filtration after normal flow losses
designIntent.fountainRole: Keep the existing Smartpond kit as the gentle visible fountain/surface-movement feature rather than relying on it as the main filtration system
designIntent.filterRole: Use separate mechanical and biological filtration with enough bio-media capacity to avoid rebuilding the system if small fish are added later
designIntent.uv: Optional later only if persistent free-floating green water becomes a problem

items.item: Smartpond Filter Kit with Pump from Lowe's
items.role: Gentle visible fountain and surface movement
items.note: Already purchased. Keep it as the fountain component; do not depend on it as the permanent mechanical/biological filtration system.

items.item: Adjustable main pond pump, approximately 300–500 GPH rated
items.role: Main circulation through the permanent filter
items.note: The Manhattan vessel is now purchased, so final pump selection can be made around its approximately 40 x 20 x 18-inch footprint and the actual plumbing/head layout.

items.item: Mechanical + biological filter with generous bio-media capacity
items.role: Solids capture plus beneficial-bacteria capacity sized with possible future fish in mind
items.note: Choose a filter that comfortably exceeds the needs of the fishless pond so a small future fish load does not require a system rebuild.

items.item: Tubing, valves/flow control and quiet return fittings
items.role: Connect pump to filter and return filtered water without adding another large visible fountain
items.note: Exact fittings depend on the selected pump/filter and placement.

shoppingList.note: The item estimates total roughly $150–235; the existing Phase 3 allowance remains $150–250 to leave room for small fittings, tax or minor adjustments. UV is not included as a required purchase.

notBuyingNow: UV clarifier unless persistent green water later justifies it
Dedicated fish aeration equipment unless the future fish-readiness review shows it is needed

completionMemory.title: End of Phase 3
completionMemory.caption: Permanent circulation, filtration and fountain system installed and running.

contentNote: Preserve existing Phase 3 notes and decision history when rendering this data. This file adds the fish-ready system design and estimated-vs-actual shopping structure.
